# retrieval score

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:retrievalScore`](gmeow-retrievalScore.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/retrievalScore>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

Statement-level annotation: the relevance score a retrieval (or re-ranker) assigned to ONE [`retrievedChunk`](gmeow-retrievedChunk.md) triple. An annotation property so competing scores coexist attributed (P9) and the OWL downcast stays DL-clean (P3).

## Structure

**Property shape:** annotation property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:retrievalScore`](gmeow-retrievalScore.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
